title: 2 piece sheer window
text: 2 piece sheer window. These are indeed just for mood... they are incredibly thin/sheer.  I just wanted something to soften the wide wooden blinds I have.  Does the trick.  The ivory is a yellowish tint... like ivory would be.  The length and width given are accurate.  Just keep in mind they are "sheers" and therefore really just soften a window.  Also, you will need to iron them out of the package.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful, nor do I shy away from answering comments/questions.  I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.  My purchases are VERIFIED, FULL price and 100% independent.  As are my reviews!  They are fully my opinion, which could differ from yours - and that's ok.  Happy shopping!

product_metadata.title: HLC.ME 2 Piece Sheer Voile Window Curtain Grommet Panels for Bedroom & Living Room (54" W x 95" L, Black)
features: Beautiful Sheer Curtain Grommet Panels will liven up your indoor or outdoor spaces with a sense of airiness and beauty. Made from solid color polyester voile. Bring elegance and class to any room with this light filtering sheer curtains. Our luxurious sheer panels give your home a new & elegant look. Allows natural light to flow through the room. For a full look use two (2) panels to cover a standard window. This picture shows two (2) sheer panels and this package contains two (2) Panels.
Construction: The header on the panel measures 4" inch, bottom hem measures 2" inch, side hem measures 1" inch.
8 Grommets per panel; Color of Grommets: Brushed Nickel; Content: Two (2) Voile Sheer Curtain Grommet Panels
Material: Polyester / Style: Voile Sheer Grommet / Machine Washable

details.Product Care Instructions: Curtains got a little dusty? Don't fret! Simply toss the curtains in the wash on a cold cycle. Then tumble dry them in the dryer so that they are smooth to the touch. But be sure that you do not bleach them so that they maintain their beauty.
